title: DSCR Generator Tie In
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DCSO.DCSO RICHMOND.DCSO RICHMOND DIVISION #1
description_text: Sources Sought Performing market research for this requirement. This will likely be an Invitation for Bid (IFB) in support of Defense Supply Center Richmond (DSCR). The requirement is to tie in additional generators and electrical systems to Building 46 at DSCR. Please indicate your interest with specific past performance and capabilities statement to the Contracting Officer, Brandon Jump, at brandon.jump@dla.mil by the deadline. See relevant attachments enclosed.
